source: Every person trusts some person. Therefore some person is trusted by every person.

claims.text: Therefore some person is trusted by every person.

evidence.quote: Therefore some person is trusted by every person.

formalization.domain_description: The domain consists of all people.

translations.reason: Universal quantifier over x (every person), existential quantifier over y (some person) for the trust relation.
Existential quantifier over y (some person), universal quantifier over x (every person) for the trust relation.

interpretation_notes: The premise allows each person to trust a different person (dependent choice), while the conclusion requires a single person trusted by all (independent choice). The formalization preserves this distinction in quantifier order.
The argument's validity depends on domain properties not specified here (e.g., whether the domain is finite).
